Pricing — three plans, one flat rate

A technical SEO audit checks whether crawlers can reach, render and index your pages before anyone argues about keywords. The order matters: a crawl block costs 100% of visibility, a weak meta description costs a click-through rate.

What does a technical SEO audit cover?

It covers six areas: crawl access, indexation, rendering, canonicalisation, performance and structured data. Each one gates the next, so a fix list sorted by severity beats a fix list sorted by effort.

  • Crawl access: robots.txt and server status codes
  • Indexation: meta robots, canonical tags, sitemap accuracy
  • Rendering: server-rendered body text for every indexable URL

How long does it take?

A 200-URL audit takes three business days and costs 2400 USD. A 5000-URL audit takes two weeks and costs 7800 USD, because log-file analysis dominates the time.
